description: This Java class 'StagedCommandStrategy' implements a command handling strategy within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract connectivity command strategy to process 'StagedCommand' objects, generating results based on the command's event and response.

classes.name: StagedCommandStrategy
classes.description: Final class implementing a command strategy for handling 'StagedCommand' objects, extending 'AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy'. It constructs mutation results related to the command's event and response.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to process the context, entity, command, and metadata, returning a Result wrapping a ConnectivityEvent based on the provided command.
